name: Voltage Finance
rootCause: Voltage Finance has been exploited for ~$4M via its partner Ola Finance. Earlier this month, a similar incident on the xDAI chain gave the teams using Compound’s code plenty of warning. But somehow, neither Voltage nor Ola got the news.
